title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E2 — One-Pot Meals
Stovetop clambake in a stockpot; risotto with shrimp and herbs in a pressure cooker; poached cod with tomatoes in a skillet; arroz con pollo in a Dutch oven.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E4 — Mushrooms
Buckwheat crêpes filled with a mushroom mixture; vegetarian mushroom ragù served on rigatoni; French mushroom soup; mushroom risotto made with farro.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E11 — Southwest
Anise seed-flavored cookies called biscochitos; flan, a custard topped with caramel; tres leches cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E12 — South
Buttermilk pie; bourbon bread pudding; carrot cake with orange cream cheese frosting.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E1 — Updated Classics
Rhubarb and raspberry rye crisps; flaky buttermilk barley biscuits; spelt layer cake with whipped cream and berries.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E2 — Coffee Shop Favorites
Apple cider doughnut cake with whole grain wheat flour and applesauce; maple-glazed pumpkin spelt scones; seeded graham biscotti.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E3 — For the Cookie Jar
Pecan, oat and dark chocolate chunk cookies; chewy molasses crinkles; slice-and-bake buckwheat espresso cookies.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E4 — Alternative Crusts
Plum galette with a cornmeal crust; dairy-free chocolate coconut pie; whole-wheat olive oil-crusted mushroom tart with tahini.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E5 — Flour Power
Custardy-herb quiche with a malty rye crust; blueberry coffee cake with muesli topping; a seeded quick bread.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E7 — Yeasted Breakfast Favorites
Hazelnut hot cross buns with dried cherries; honeyed whole-wheat bread; pull-apart whole-wheat monkey bread.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E1 — Today's Catch: Fish Recipes for Everyday
Hannah Heimbuch and Martha demonstrate how to prepare fish for cooking; Chef Marcus Samuelsson makes cured king salmon and halibut en papillote; Martha breaks down a Dungeness crab.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E2 — India: A Tour of Food
Martha's friend and restaurateur, Shiva Natarajan, shares the key to making any Indian dish - spices; back in Martha's kitchen, they make butter chicken, lemon rice, and a tangy yogurt sauce.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E3 — Magic Mushrooms
Martha learns about the magic of mushrooms; mushroom expert Andrew Carter explains each mushroom variety; Martha and mushroom cookbook author Andrea Gentl make delicious mushroom recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E6 — The Bagel Show
Martha samples bagel toppings and is joined by Gary Greengrass, owner of Barney Greengrass, an NYC staple; at PopUp Bagels, Martha makes bagels and constructs breakfast sandwiches with Adam Goldberg.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E8 — Vegan Cuisine Redefined
Martha and Chef Daniel Humm make redefined vegan dishes; Martha and Chef Daniel make a refreshing cocktail and gazpacho, followed by mushroom and seaweed baked rice and a rhubarb cobbler for dessert.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E9 — Authentic Greek Cuisine
Martha and Chef Costas Spiliadis of Estiatorio Milos make Taramasalata and salad; they build an eggplant and zucchini tower with tzatziki; then, they salt-bake a fish served with yogurt.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E4 — Chef David Burke's Modern Classics
Chef David Burke brings his modern classic dishes to Martha's kitchen; a bacon clothesline, calamari noodles, miso chicken with ginger and vegetables, and key lime pie are on the menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E6 — Sensational Summer Salads
Martha and Salad Freak author Jess Dameck reveal the art of constructing the perfect salad; Martha and Sarah Carey share a new twist on the classic Caesar salad and create a roasted beet salad.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S9 E52 — Bride of Frankenstein
Halloween costumes; artworks by Damien Hirst; Halloween tray liners; Monte Cristo sandwich; creamy tomato soup.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S10 E34 — Halloween
Spider-cake kit; adding flowers to pumpkins and gourds.
